title: Procurement Accelerator: Self-Serve Risk Bundles & Insurance SLAs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Enterprise procurement for Redwood inference customers is slow and inconsistent due to ad-hoc SOC2 artifact requests, negotiable insurance requirements, and bespoke contract edits. This increases sales cycle time and creates manual work for Legal and Security. Goal: Create a self-serve ‘Procurement Accelerator’ offering — a set of pre-bundled procurement artifacts and optional insurance-backed options combined with a vendor portal workflow to reduce time-to-contract and standardize risk assessments. This ticket defines scope for PM-led pricing/packaging experiments and the initial security questionnaire/insurance integration required for a pilot.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Reduce median procurement time for pilot customers by >=25% compared to baseline (measured from NDA to signed MSA)
A2: Deliver a documented set of 3 risk bundles (Lite, Standard, Enterprise) that map to legal template clauses and insurance options
A3: SOC2 artifact pack (attestation letter, control narrative snapshot, scoping appendix) staged in vendor portal for automated download
A4: Insurance options integrated as selectable SKUs in pricing sheet and verified with at least one insurance partner
A5: Legal and Security sign-off on the standardized bundle templates and the portal onboarding flow
A6: Pilot with 3 sales opportunities completed and feedback captured as structured notes
milestones: Discovery: stakeholder interviews and baseline procurement metrics (2 weeks)
Design: define risk bundles, pricing experiments, and portal UX (3 weeks)
Legal/Security review: finalize template language and required evidence (2 weeks)
Engineering: portal MVP to surface artifact downloads and bundle selection (4 weeks)
Pilot: run with 3 target accounts and iterate (6 weeks)
Launch: roll out self-serve bundle to enterprise onboarding flows and update sales materials (2 weeks)
